versions.content: Invoke the configured <ComUser_ComCbkTrigger- Transmit> if SwCluC_ComProxy_ComCbkTriggerTransmit is called Status: DRAFT If the <ComUser_ComCbkTriggerTransmit> notification callback is configured in the Com High Proxy (via the ComUserCallbackName (See [ECUC_Com_10036]) parameter, where the ComUserCallbackType (See [ECUC_Com_10034]) is set to COM_TX_TRIGGER_TRANSMIT ), the configured <ComUser_ComCbkTriggerTrans- mit> callback shall be invoked, when the associated instance of the SwCluC_- ComProxy_ComCbkTriggerTransmit from the Com Low Proxy is called.
